answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 9030 Country: India Title: When a muslim slaughters a bird in the way prescribed in shariyah to get halal flesh, if a non-muslim helps him by holding the bird during slaughering, will it become haram? Question: When a muslim slaughters a bird in the way prescribed in shariyah to get halal flesh, if a non-muslim helps him by holding the bird during slaughering, will it become haram? Answer ID: 9030 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1180/1180=M/1429) If the non-Muslim person is only helping in holding the bird during slaughtering and the slaughtering is made by the Muslim after reciting BismiAllah then the slaughtered animal is halal. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
